description: Finish concrete and fill joints in mechanical room B-012 of an office basement during a pump replacement, with a Franka Mobile FR3 Duo (holonomic base, lift, two FR3 arms with Franka Hands). A new pump pad (1219 x 914 x 89 mm inside 2x4 forms) is darbied, edged, floated and steel-troweled; a floor patch where the old pad was broken out is struck off flush and floated; the joints of a CMU infill are tooled concave; a sealant control joint is tooled; anchor holes and a mesh patch in a gypsum partition are filled and knifed flush. Tools are free rigid bodies with the maker's dimensions held by fingertip friction (Marshalltown 145D float, 144D wood float, PB64D trowel, 4626D darby, 136D edger, 52D margin trowel, BJCC12 jointer, JK886D and PK878D knives, a sealant tool, a pocket penetrometer). Concrete, repair mortar, masonry mortar, sealant and compound are 2.5-D yield-stress fields on 1-4 mm cells whose strength grows with age, that bleed and evaporate, and that a tool shapes only by contact; the paste carries a tool by its bearing capacity through a support plate under the sole. A wait command advances the material clock while the robot holds still.
count_scope: nine named tasks in preset b012: pad-darby (medium), pad-edge (medium), pad-float (medium), pad-trowel (hard), pad-finish (expert: the whole timeline with waits), patch-flush (medium), tool-joints (medium), tool-sealant (easy-medium), patch-drywall (easy-medium); seeds vary the surface features of each start state and the site within +-2 C and +-20 % bleed; variant sets the site's conditions (default, door, fan, hot, cool, fast-sealant)
split_note: Frozen by hash of (task, seed) over seeds 0..999 of every task (concrete_finishing/variations.json); seeds 1000..9999 resolve with split null.

evaluator.scope: Material state only: heights against straightedges, planes and arcs, aggregate exposure, densification, texture, sealing, water worked in, trapped water and blisters, what each cell recorded when it was last worked (its yield stress then, whether after initial set), wall contact of sealant, smear; forms' contact history; tools on the cart. No autonomous-solution claim.
evaluator.task_set_source: concrete_finishing/task_set_progress.py (explicit contract only); task.py stays the default

qualification: Component-qualified with assisted evidence: start states at rest, the support plate carrying a pressed sliding float exactly (B4), strength and bleeding against their laws, and robot-held demonstrations by a scripted operator through the robot interface; phantom forces where labelled.

task_set.score_rule: 1 on success; otherwise 0.95 x progress from the seed-specific start. pad-finish retains pad-finish/progress-v3. Other entries explicitly select concrete-tasks/progress-v1; bare selections retain their legacy scores.
task_set.selection_note: All eight are existing tasks with unchanged start states, instructions and IDs. pad-float stays registered outside this set. Assisted component demonstrations exist; no whole-task robot solution has been shown.
task_set.qualification: Tested with constructed material states and a stubbed backend only; the concrete-tasks/progress-v1 evaluator has not yet been run with the simulator.
